scope: m=35 n=25 q=127 sigma=2 eta=2, ONE instance, TOY SCALE. No ML-KEM break claim, no security proof, no FIPS 203 parameter set affected or cleared.
purpose: RAW VECTORS, archived so every certificate in results.json is checkable from the snapshot alone without regenerating anything (EV-MLKEM-ba6c25 OBS-3).
how_to_check: for each family F: numpy.mod(numpy.array(F['X']).dot(numpy.array(A)) - numpy.array(F['Y']), 127) must be all zero.  For STAGEB use A_lat = A[:, :15].
